differences: One read-only diagnostic on completed O0n3seed0, not a new training recipe or an inference admission gate. Original C004 failure, source and checkpoint stay unchanged. Encoder remains float32; all predictor modes consume the same generated history/actions. CPU is reference only.
contrary_evidence: Float64 agreement on two selected batches cannot certify training updates, full encoder/predictor gradients, O1 masking, all planning inputs or scientific quality. Common-history conditioning changes the rollout input distribution; it is an accumulation diagnostic, not a physical prediction score. Failure may persist, and CPU is not an exact mathematical oracle.
